scope: Whole surviving1872Bodie Island Lighthouse permanent exterior and intrinsic attached oil house/workroom/passage: five broad white-black-white-black-white shaft bands, octagonal dressed granite base, five narrow recessed shaft windows in opposing3/2groups, four upper service windows, flared corbelled two-level black galleries/open rails,16-sided glazed lantern/roof/ventilator ball, plus low white gabled oil house with four sash windows, west entrance/transom/three-bracket gabled canopy/four steps and two brick chimney caps. Exclude detached DoubleKeepersQuarters/visitorcenter/storehouse/cisterns, site fence/paved paths/boardwalk/marsh/landscape, interiors/Fresnel lens replica/lettering/people/vehicles and temporary scaffolding. Original native plan fixes identity/center/axis; official measured architectural text controls scale where approximate mapped envelope differs.
